name: TrackMania Nations Forever
notes: Use the dedicated DirectX 9 Metal path with TrackMania's tuned audio and scene settings. The OpenGL fallback is available if rendering fails, but can be considerably slower. Performance varies by hardware and track.

name: Counter-Strike 2
notes: Use DXMT for CS2's DirectX 11 graphics. The combined DirectX 9–11 profile also includes this backend. The owner confirmed working window controls, online matchmaking and satisfactory performance after restoring Steam's normal overlay handling in the clean environment. The tuned preset targets 60 FPS on the tested M4. This local result does not establish a minimum frame rate across every map, monitor or Mac.
